ConnectionStrings.// DefaultConnection: Demo-only LocalDB database shared with the Worker demo host: the message store, the demo_transport queue tables and demo.Orders all live here. The E2E fixture overrides it from CLOUDSTRAP_TEST_SQL when set (spec D-3).

JwtBearer.// RequireAuthenticatedEndpoints: Deliberately NOT set: this host is the live demo of #5's hardened default (true) — every endpoint demands a validated token via the fallback policy, no [Authorize] attribute anywhere; only the health probes stay anonymous.

Messaging.// Transport: SqlServer: queue tables on ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection. The durability schema is workload-derived (demo_application_api) — the Worker's is demo_application_worker, both in the one database (AC-MSG13 visible).

SqlTransport.// SchemaName: Sender and listener must share the queue-table schema — an explicit demo decision, not a package opinion.

Destinations.// Cloudstrap.Demo.Contracts: Commands from the contracts namespace go to the Worker's workload queue.

Messaging.// AutoProvision: Not set: on in Development (the E2E fixture runs this host as Development), off elsewhere.
